title: Forlorn Cavern
wikitext:
[[Image:The Forlorn Cavern.jpg|thumb|The Forlorn Cavern]]
'''The Forlorn Cavern''' is a long, winding road built around Ironforge's underground lake.  It's naturally dark and secluded nature makes it perfect for lots of shady deals. [[Warlock]] and [[rogue]] trainers can be found here, as well as vendors catering to those classes.

To get to the Forlorn Cavern, you can head east from the [[Mystic Ward]] or west from the [[Hall of Explorers]].
